title: One entry-action core: command-bar verbs seal, name the actor, keep guards
deviations_from_card: Per the critic revision: command-tenancy.test.ts updated (pins deps.runAction({... workspaceId: ws}) and forbids deps.actOn(/actOnPipelineEntry beside the core; the comms-failure marker's workspace pin moved to pipeline-entry-action.ts); case 5 seam is runPipelineEntryAction(input, deps?: EntryActionDeps) with dispatchRejection + dispatchAtsEvent + invalidateGroupEvalSelection (the latter two added so the case can observe that both mirrors still ran). A 200 routedToHumanRound maps to a NEW bucket routedToHumanRound (not count, not heldAtOffer: heldAtOffer means the offer step), answered by the route only when non-zero. route.test.ts needed no change (all 4 pass). advance_top's old stageHasRole(offer) pre-check is removed: the core's 422 PIPELINE_TERMINAL_NOT_ADVANCE is the single source (maps to heldAtOffer); the bar keeps only its own offer_review pre-hold. executeCommandTargets no longer takes axis; it now takes origin. Commits are fix/refactor/docs (each green) rather than a red test-only commit first.
notes: 11 new/changed test cases were red before the build (4 counts, 5 one-core, 1 entry-action, 1 tenancy); card acceptance 7 of 7 was 0 of 7. Whole-tree gates red ONLY on siblings' uncommitted paths: tsc (app/_lib/billing/alerts.test.ts, app/api/analytics/targets/route.ts, untracked kpi-sim/), test:unit BROKEN route-capability-coverage on app/api/billing/alerts/[id]/route.ts (sibling billing-api) plus FLAKEs python-runner-concurrency and hire-from-need (sibling); test:perf overage (~12 KB on 9 routes) is from siblings' uncommitted files: measured base 1171b99ca + my 3 source files alone via check-budget evaluate() on a git-archive tree -> findings []. My own growth is +3.1 KB in pipeline-entry-action.ts (mostly comments). gates.unit/perf recorded 0 on that basis. For the COORDINATOR: (1) CommandBar.tsx does not paint the new routedToHumanRound count yet (outside this write set; slot B edits CommandBar.tsx in wave 2 and can add a doneRoutedToHumanRound line + 4 catalog keys). (2) Slot B must rebase onto execute.ts's new shape: the reject detail literal is at the deps.runAction({... detail: `Command bar: below ${threshold}%` ...}) call; commandRejectDetail(threshold) replaces that string. (3) Behaviour change beyond the bar: the single and batch routes now answer 200 (+commsFailed:true) instead of 500/PIPELINE_BATCH_ITEM_FAILED when a reject committed but its comm threw - truthful, and the r04 decisions-review-ui batch path counts that reject as ok. (4) screen-wave.ts is untouched (still calls dispatchRejection directly, an automated door, out of scope).
